title: PointRAFT: 3D deep learning for high-throughput prediction of potato tuber weight from partial point clouds
abstract: arXiv:2512.24193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Key phenotypic traits, such as crop size, volume, and weight, can be estimated non-destructively from point clouds. In practice, however, point clouds of crops are typically incomplete due to self-occlusion, leading to systematic errors when estimating these traits. To overcome this limitation, crop traits can be inferred directly from incomplete point clouds using deep learning-based regression networks. These networks, however, may perform suboptimally, because their predictions do not incorporate prior geometric knowledge of the crop. Such geometric knowledge is often available in structured settings, such as on a potato harvester, where the fixed distance between the camera and the conveyor belt allows tuber height to be derived from the point cloud. translated_title: PointRAFT：基于部分点云高通量预测马铃薯块茎重量的3D深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 关键表型性状，如作物大小、体积和重量，可以通过点云进行无损估计。然而在实际应用中，由于自遮挡效应，作物的点云通常是不完整的，这会导致估计这些性状时产生系统性误差。为了克服这一限制，可以使用基于深度学习的回归网络直接从不完整的点云中推断作物性状。然而，这些网络的表现可能欠佳，因为其预测并未融入作物的先验几何知识。这类几何知识在结构化环境中通常是可获得的，例如在马铃薯收获机上，相机与传送带之间的固定距离使得块茎高度可以从点云中推导出来。为了利用这一几何线索，我们提出了PointRAFT，一种通过专门的高度嵌入模块来融合物体高度信息的高通量点云回归网络。
tldr: 本文提出PointRAFT，一种融合块茎高度先验几何知识的高通量点云回归网络，能够从不完整的点云中准确预测马铃薯块茎重量。
en_tdlr: PointRAFT is a high-throughput point cloud regression network that incorporates prior geometric knowledge of object height to accurately predict potato tuber weight from partial point clouds.
